info.name: shop-purchase
info.description: Purchase scenario through the shop entrance (nginx of the frontend -> API Gateway): registration, welcome e-mail, login, catalog, product page, stock (ADMIN), cart and access denials. Run with bash postman/run.sh compose (postman/README.md). Checks are named [S<nn>]; checks of team services that do not accept UUID yet (Inventory, Review) or do not exist (Order, Shipping) are skipped with a reason. At most 2 logins per run (rate limit 5/min).

item.name: 00 setup
item.description: Probes: which team services accept UUID productId (Inventory, Review) and which are registered in Consul (Order, Shipping). Dependent checks are skipped with one of the 4 fixed reasons.

exec: // Run setup. run.mjs puts runId and customerEmail into the environment; the Postman app has neither,
// so a new pair (a new customer account) is made for every run there.
// S01: 200/404 = UUID supported; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with "integer" in the message = UUID rejected, the dependent
// checks are skipped. Any other answer fails this probe and the dependent checks run (and fail) instead of being skipped.

item.description: Placeholder of the order flow (stage 8): skipped while Order and Shipping are not registered in Consul, failing once they are.

exec: // S80: the order flow comes in stage 8. Without order-service the check is skipped; once order-service is registered
